title: Great God, with Wonder and with Praise
description: Great God, with Wonder and with Praise in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 190 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Sufficiency of the Scriptures”, where the book credits them to the Episcopal Collection.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Great God, with won-der and with praise On all thy works I look; But still thy wis-dom, power, and grace, Shine bright-est in thy book.

lines: Great God, with wonder and with praise
On all thy works I look;
But still thy wisdom, power, and grace,
Here are my choicest treasures hid;
Lord, make me understand thy law;
Show what my faults have been;
And from thy gospel let me draw

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to YORK by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
